machine: Apple M3 Ultra, 80-core GPU, 512 GB unified memory

policy_definition.cutoff: layers 3..c-1 packed Direct fallback; c..44 grouped FP8

router_metric_definitions.slot_position_mismatches: top-8 slot positions that differ; includes order-only changes
router_metric_definitions.tokens_with_changed_top8_set: layer-token rows whose unordered expert-ID set differs
router_metric_definitions.expert_membership_replacements: Direct expert IDs absent from the actual top-8, summed over layer-token rows
router_metric_definitions.tokens_with_order_only_change: layer-token rows with the same expert set but a different order
router_metric_definitions.score_difference_by_expert_id: actual minus Direct score after matching slots by expert ID

measurement_method.correctness_sweep: one fresh-cache pass per cutoff with router capture; all-grouped compile warmup excluded
measurement_method.candidate_performance: router capture disabled; 2 warmups then median of 5 measured fresh-cache passes
measurement_method.direct_performance: 2 warmups then median of 5 measured fresh-cache passes

screening.selection_decision: do not promote a suffix runtime; no correctness-screened cutoff reaches 1.5x, so return to grouped-kernel numerical ordering
